name: Daffodil Bouquet
summary: In Lakeshire, Guard Parker sends a bouquet to thank Darcy for packing his lunch. Martie Jainrose gathers the flowers, and their choice stirs gossip between the two women.

sections.title: A Tangled Token
sections.body: Guard Parker wants to thank Darcy at the Lakeshire inn for packing his daily lunch. He asks the town herbalist, Martie Jainrose, to prepare a bouquet of daffodils. Martie says they are her favorite flowers. Darcy recognizes them as Martie’s signature bloom and suspects jealousy. Half-joking, she wonders whether Martie poisoned the stems out of spite.

faq.q: What is the Daffodil Bouquet used for?
aliases: what do i do with daffodil bouquet
faq.answer: Guard Parker sends the bouquet to Darcy at the Lakeshire inn to thank her for packing and sending his lunch while he is on duty.

aliases: where did the flowers come from
faq.answer: Martie Jainrose, Lakeshire’s herbalist, gathers and binds the bouquet on request. She chooses daffodils because they are her favorite flowers.

faq.q: Why does Darcy react suspiciously to the flowers?
faq.answer: Darcy recognizes the daffodils as Martie’s favorite flowers, not a choice made especially for her. She calls Martie a jealous rival and jokes that the flowers might be tainted out of spite, but accepts the gesture.
No. Darcy’s suspicion is theatrical jealousy between the two women in Lakeshire. The flowers are harmless.

angles.text: As an herbalist in Lakeshire, you may recognize the bouquet as Martie Jainrose’s handiwork. She gathers wild flowers for her trade.
